mapper.insert: insert into abr_plan_active (visitor_id, active_date, item_count, open_count, first_time, last_time) values (#{visitorId}, cast(#{activeDate} as date), (select count(*) from abr_plan_item p where p.visitor_id = #{visitorId}), 1, now(), now()) on conflict (visitor_id, active_date) do update set item_count = excluded.item_count, open_count = abr_plan_active.open_count + 1, last_time = now()
mapper.select: with d as ( select v.visitor_id, v.app_user_id, v.channel_code, c.content_code as content_code_hit, c.title, c.playbook_code, pb.playbook_name, coalesce(c.account_id, a.account_id) as account_id, coalesce(ca.account_name, a.account_name) as account_name from abr_visitor v left join abr_content c on c.content_code = v.content_code and v.content_code <> '' left join abr_channel_account ca on ca.account_id = c.account_id left join abr_channel_account a on a.account_code = v.channel_code left join abr_playbook pb on pb.playbook_code = c.playbook_code where v.merged_into is null and v.del_flag = '0' and v.create_time >= cast(#{beginDate} as date) and v.create_time < cast(#{endDate} as date) + interval '1 day' ), f as ( select d.*, (exists (select 1 from abr_tool_run t where t.visitor_id = d.visitor_id) or exists (select 1 from abr_assessment s where s.visitor_id = d.visitor_id and s.submitted_time is not null)) as tool_used, (exists (select 1 from abr_event e where e.visitor_id = d.visitor_id and e.event_type = 'plan_item_added') or exists (select 1 from abr_plan_item p where p.visitor_id = d.visitor_id)) as plan_added, exists (select 1 from abr_event e where e.visitor_id = d.visitor_id and e.event_type = 'plan_moment') as moment, exists (select 1 from abr_booking b where b.status <> 'cancelled' and (b.visitor_id = d.visitor_id or (d.app_user_id is not null and b.app_user_id = d.app_user_id) or b.lead_id in (select coalesce(l.merged_into, l.lead_id) from abr_lead l where l.visitor_id = d.visitor_id or (d.app_user_id is not null and l.app_user_id = d.app_user_id)))) as booked, exists (select 1 from abr_lead l join abr_lead k on k.lead_id = coalesce(l.merged_into, l.lead_id) where (l.visitor_id = d.visitor_id or (d.app_user_id is not null and l.app_user_id = d.app_user_id)) and k.stage = 'won' and k.del_flag = '0') as signed from d ) select as group_key, max() as group_label, count(*) as visitors, count(*) filter (where d.tool_used) as tool_users, count(*) filter (where d.plan_added) as plan_users, count(*) filter (where d.app_user_id is not null) as login_users, count(*) filter (where d.moment) as moment_users, count(*) filter (where d.booked) as booked_users, count(*) filter (where d.signed) as signed_users from f d group by 1 order by visitors desc, group_key

with d as ( select r.record_id, r.metrics, c.content_id, a.account_code as channel_code, c.content_code as content_code_hit, c.title, c.playbook_code, pb.playbook_name, r.account_id, a.account_name from abr_publish_record r join abr_content c on c.content_id = r.content_id join abr_channel_account a on a.account_id = r.account_id left join abr_playbook pb on pb.playbook_code = c.playbook_code where r.status = 'published' and coalesce(r.published_time, r.planned_time) >= cast(#{beginDate} as date) and coalesce(r.published_time, r.planned_time) < cast(#{endDate} as date) + interval '1 day' ) select as group_key, max() as group_label, count(distinct d.content_id) as published, coalesce(sum(cast(d.metrics ->> 'views' as bigint)), 0) as views, coalesce(sum(coalesce(cast(d.metrics ->> 'likes' as bigint), 0) + coalesce(cast(d.metrics ->> 'favorites' as bigint), 0) + coalesce(cast(d.metrics ->> 'comments' as bigint), 0) + coalesce(cast(d.metrics ->> 'shares' as bigint), 0)), 0) as interactions, coalesce(sum(cast(d.metrics ->> 'dms' as bigint)), 0) as dms, coalesce(sum(cast(d.metrics ->> 'follows' as bigint)), 0) as follows from d group by 1

select visitor_id, to_char(first_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as first_date, to_char(active_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as active_date from ( select visitor_id, active_date, min(active_date) over (partition by visitor_id) as first_date from abr_plan_active where item_count > 0 ) t where first_date >= cast(#{since} as date) order by visitor_id, active_date

select to_char(date_trunc('week', active_date), 'YYYY-MM-DD') as week, count(distinct visitor_id) filter (where item_count > 0) as active, count(distinct visitor_id) as opened from abr_plan_active where active_date >= cast(#{since} as date) group by 1 order by 1

select count(*) as total, count(*) filter (where v.channel_code in #{ch}) as natural_count from abr_visitor v where v.merged_into is null and v.del_flag = '0' and v.create_time >= cast(#{beginDate} as date) and v.create_time < cast(#{endDate} as date) + interval '1 day'

select count(distinct a.visitor_id) as active, count(distinct a.visitor_id) filter (where exists ( select 1 from abr_event e where e.visitor_id = a.visitor_id and e.event_type = 'plan_share_created' and e.create_time >= cast(#{beginDate} as date) and e.create_time < cast(#{endDate} as date) + interval '1 day')) as sharers from abr_plan_active a where a.item_count > 0 and a.active_date >= cast(#{beginDate} as date) and a.active_date <= cast(#{endDate} as date)
